comment: Pinned host toolchains, installed without admin rights under installRoot by scripts/setup-toolchains.ps1. Each download is checked against its SHA-256.

tools.purpose: Clang + LLD toolchain targeting x86_64-w64-mingw32 (UCRT). Builds PS2Recomp's tools and the native Windows game runners without MSVC.
tools.license: LLVM: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; mingw-w64 runtime/headers: ZPL-2.1 / MIT-style (see the LICENSE files inside the archive)

tools.purpose: Offline 4x super-resolution of dumped game textures for HD texture packs (pc-compat route); runs on any Vulkan GPU. An external tool: it is run on texture dumps in work/, never shipped with a game.
tools.license: Real-ESRGAN and its models: BSD-3-Clause (xinntao/Real-ESRGAN); ncnn-vulkan port: MIT (xinntao/Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan); vcomp140.dll: Microsoft VC++ redistributable
tools.sha256Note: GitHub publishes no digest for this 2022 asset; hash recorded at first download (2026-10-18) and enforced from then on.
